## Accessibility checklist

- [ ] Any new or changed content has been read aloud (or tested with a screen reader).
- [ ] Any new visuals have a text description.
- [ ] New interactive elements are keyboard-operable and have visible focus.
- [ ] Colour is not the only way information is conveyed.
- [ ] Synthetic data is clearly labelled as synthetic everywhere it appears.
- [ ] Real data includes full provenance (mission, archive, identifier, license/terms, caveats).

## Scientific accuracy checklist (for lesson changes)

- [ ] All scientific claims are supported by a cited, reliable source.
- [ ] Claims use appropriately cautious language (e.g. "may", "suggests", "is consistent with").
- [ ] The lesson does not imply that planned SAGAN features (live data pipeline, GAN model) are already implemented.
